test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 14 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Amit starts from Point Y and drives 8 km towards the north. He then takes a right turn, drives 12 km, turns right and drives 11 km. He then takes a right turn and drives 15 km. He takes a final right turn, drives 3 km and stops at Point Z. How far and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point Y from Point Z? (All turns are 90 degree turns only)
solution:
Draw the diagram according to the given information which is as follows,

 
• Starting point is Y.
 
• Drives 8 km towards the north and then take a right turn and drive 12 km.
 
• Then again take a right turn and drives 11 km.
 
• Then again take a right turn and drives 15 km.
 
• Finally take a right turn and drive 3 km and stop at point Z.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c376f9f15c472fc1e6fe31abc08f4b2a6700a92525b00ab0ff7582c935d3eef6.png] 

So, he needs to drive 3 km towards east to reach Point Y from Point Z.

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 1".**
